plugin.name: XP_Rate_Tracker
plugin.author: Claude / modified by ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Resizable XP/AP/Gold rate tracker with live graph
plugin.description:
USAGE:
rates show rates hide rates reset
rates hour rates minute rates toggle
Automatically catches lines like:
You receive 21700 XP, 48 AP, and 1063 gold.
Tracks running totals plus XP/AP/Gold rates.
Graph history covers approximately one hour.
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
Win = GetPluginID()
------------------------------------------------------------ -- WINDOW SIZE -- Matches Exit Compass exactly ------------------------------------------------------------
WINDOW_WIDTH = 390 WINDOW_HEIGHT = 215
TITLE_HEIGHT = 24
FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" FONT_SIZE = 9
LINE_HEIGHT = 16
TEXT_INSET = 10 VALUE_GAP = 18
-------------------------------------------------- -- RESIZABLE MINIWINDOW -------------------------------------------------- RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE = 14 MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH = 260 MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT = 175 resizeActive = false
function LoadWindowSize() local w = tonumber(GetVariable("xp_width")) local h = tonumber(GetVariable("xp_height")) if w then WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) end if h then WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) end end
function SaveWindowSize() SetVariable("xp_width", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH))) SetVariable("xp_height", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT))) end
function ResizeMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) resizeActive = true; return 0 end
function UpdateResizeFromMouse() local mouseX = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 17)) local mouseY = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 18)) local left = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 1)) or 0 local top = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 2)) or 0 if not mouseX or not mouseY then return false end local newW = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(mouseX - left + 1)) local newH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(mouseY - top + 1)) if newW == WINDOW_WIDTH and newH == WINDOW_HEIGHT then return false end WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT = newW, newH WindowResize(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR) Redraw() return true end
function ResizeMouseMove(flags, hotspot_id) if resizeActive then UpdateResizeFromMouse() end SetCursor(miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow) return 0 end
function ResizeMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) if resizeActive then UpdateResizeFromMouse() end resizeActive = false SaveWindowSize() movewindow.add_drag_handler(Win,0,0,0,TITLE_HEIGHT) WindowDeleteHotspot(Win,"rate_reset_button") WindowDeleteHotspot(Win,"rate_toggle_button") WindowAddHotspot(Win,"rate_reset_button",WINDOW_WIDTH-106,TITLE_HEIGHT+6,WINDOW_WIDTH-58,TITLE_HEIGHT+25,"","","","","RateResetClick","Reset rates",miniwin.cursor_hand,0) WindowAddHotspot(Win,"rate_toggle_button",WINDOW_WIDTH-55,TITLE_HEIGHT+6,WINDOW_WIDTH-7,TITLE_HEIGHT+25,"","","","","RateToggleClick","Toggle hourly/minute rates",miniwin.cursor_hand,0) Redraw_Window() return 0 end
function InstallResizeHandle() WindowDeleteHotspot(Win, "00_resize") local l = math.max(0, WINDOW_WIDTH - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE) local t = math.max(0, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE) WindowAddHotspot(Win, "00_resize", l, t, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, "", "", "ResizeMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(Win, "00_resize", "ResizeMouseMove", "ResizeMouseUp", 0) WindowLine(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH-11, WINDOW_HEIGHT-3, WINDOW_WIDTH-3, WINDOW_HEIGHT-11, BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) WindowLine(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH-7, WINDOW_HEIGHT-3, WINDOW_WIDTH-3, WINDOW_HEIGHT-7, BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- GRAPH SETTINGS -- -- 120 samples x 30 seconds = 60 minutes ------------------------------------------------------------
GRAPH_MAX_SAMPLES = 120
GRAPH_MARGIN = 10 GRAPH_HEIGHT = 95 GRAPH_GAP = 4
------------------------------------------------------------ -- SHARED UI THEMES ------------------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "xp"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
-------------------------------------------------------- -- CLASSIC -- -- Preserves the original tracker colours exactly. --------------------------------------------------------
classic = {
background = "#000000", border = "#808080", title_bar = "darkslategray", title_text = "#FFD700", label = "#D4D0C8",
xp = "#70FF64", ap = "#64C8FF", gold = "#FFD700",
graph_border = "#404040", graph_bg = "#0A0A0A", graph_grid = "#202020" },
-------------------------------------------------------- -- AMBER TERMINAL -- -- Three related amber phosphor intensities keep the -- three graph series distinct without becoming a -- rainbow palette. --------------------------------------------------------
amber = {
background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title_text = "#FFB347", label = "#C9792A",
xp = "#FFD18A", ap = "#E9943A", gold = "#FFB347",
graph_border = "#5A3213", graph_bg = "#080401", graph_grid = "#2D1809" },
-------------------------------------------------------- -- DEFAULT / GREEN TERMINAL --------------------------------------------------------
default = {
background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title_text = "#9AFF82", label = "#62C962",
xp = "#C2FFAE", ap = "#72DD72", gold = "#9AFF82",
graph_border = "#1F4B1F", graph_bg = "#000800", graph_grid = "#102A10" }
}
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ACTIVE COLOUR PALETTE ------------------------------------------------------------
function LoadTheme()
local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[theme] then theme = "default" end
local T = THEMES[theme]
BACKGROUND_COLOUR = ThemeColour("background", T.background)
BORDER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("border", T.border)
TITLE_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar)
TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_text", T.title_text)
LABEL_COLOUR = ThemeColour("label", T.label)
XP_COLOUR = ThemeColour("xp", T.xp)
AP_COLOUR = ThemeColour("ap", T.ap)
GOLD_COLOUR = ThemeColour("gold", T.gold)
GRAPH_BORDER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("graph_border", T.graph_border)
GRAPH_BG_COLOUR = ThemeColour("graph_bg", T.graph_bg)
GRAPH_GRID_COLOUR = ThemeColour("graph_grid", T.graph_grid) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- SAFE DEFAULT BEFORE INSTALL ------------------------------------------------------------
LoadTheme()
------------------------------------------------------------ -- WINDOW STATE ------------------------------------------------------------
windowinfo = ""
valueX = TEXT_INSET + 45
------------------------------------------------------------ -- PERSISTED TOTALS ------------------------------------------------------------
totalXP = tonumber( GetVariable("totalXP") ) or 0
totalAP = tonumber( GetVariable("totalAP") ) or 0
totalGold = tonumber( GetVariable("totalGold") ) or 0
sessionStart = tonumber( GetVariable("sessionStart") ) or os.time()
------------------------------------------------------------ -- RATE MODE ------------------------------------------------------------
rateMode = GetVariable("rateMode") or "hour"
if rateMode ~= "hour" and rateMode ~= "minute" then
rateMode = "hour"
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- GRAPH HISTORY ------------------------------------------------------------
history = {}
------------------------------------------------------------ -- HELPERS ------------------------------------------------------------
function stripCommas(s)
return tonumber( ( s:gsub(",", "") ) )
end
function ElapsedSeconds()
local elapsed = os.time() - sessionStart
if elapsed < 1 then elapsed = 1 end
return elapsed
end
function ElapsedHours()
return ElapsedSeconds() / 3600
end
function ElapsedMinutes()
return ElapsedSeconds() / 60
end
function GetRate(total)
if rateMode == "minute" then
return total / ElapsedMinutes()
else
return total / ElapsedHours()
end
end
function GetGraphValue(sample,key)
local value = sample[key]
if rateMode == "minute" then
return value / 60
end
return value
end
function RateSuffix()
if rateMode == "minute" then return "/min" end
return "/hr"
end
function FormatNumber(n)
local formatted = tostring( math.floor(n) )
local k
while true do
formatted,k = formatted:gsub( "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2" )
if k == 0 then break end
end
return formatted
end
function FormatElapsed()
local elapsed = os.time() - sessionStart
local h = math.floor( elapsed / 3600 )
local m = math.floor( (elapsed % 3600) / 60 )
local s = elapsed % 60
return string.format( "%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- CLICK CONTROLS ------------------------------------------------------------
function RateResetClick( flags, hotspot_id )
rate_reset( "", "", {} ) end
function RateToggleClick( flags, hotspot_id )
rate_toggle( "", "", {} ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- INSTALL ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall()
LoadTheme() LoadWindowSize()
check( WindowCreate( Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, 0, 0, BACKGROUND_COLOUR ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "body"..Win, FONT_NAME, FONT_SIZE ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, FONT_SIZE, true ) )
local widestLabel = WindowTextWidth( Win, "body"..Win, "Gold:" )
valueX = TEXT_INSET + widestLabel + VALUE_GAP
windowinfo = movewindow.install( Win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true )
WindowCreate( Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "rate_reset_button", WINDOW_WIDTH - 106, TITLE_HEIGHT + 6, WINDOW_WIDTH - 58, TITLE_HEIGHT + 25, "", "", "", "", "RateResetClick", "Reset rates", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "rate_toggle_button", WINDOW_WIDTH - 55, TITLE_HEIGHT + 6, WINDOW_WIDTH - 7, TITLE_HEIGHT + 25, "", "", "", "", "RateToggleClick", "Toggle hourly/minute rates", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
Redraw_Window()
WindowShow( Win, true )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- SAVE STATE ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginSaveState()
SaveWindowSize()
movewindow.save_state( Win )
SetVariable( "totalXP", tostring(totalXP) )
SetVariable( "totalAP", tostring(totalAP) )
SetVariable( "totalGold", tostring(totalGold) )
SetVariable( "sessionStart", tostring(sessionStart) )
SetVariable( "rateMode", rateMode )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ENABLE / DISABLE ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginEnable()
LoadTheme()
Redraw_Window()
WindowShow( Win, true )
end
function OnPluginDisable()
WindowShow( Win, false )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- GRAPH HISTORY ------------------------------------------------------------
function PushHistorySample()
local hours = ElapsedHours()
table.insert( history, { xp = totalXP / hours,
ap = totalAP / hours,
gold = totalGold / hours } )
if #history > GRAPH_MAX_SAMPLES then
table.remove( history, 1 )
end
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DRAW A GRAPH ------------------------------------------------------------
function Draw_Single_Graph( top, height, key, colour, label )
local left = GRAPH_MARGIN
local right = WINDOW_WIDTH - GRAPH_MARGIN
local bottom = top + height
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, left, top, right, bottom, GRAPH_BG_COLOUR )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, left, top, right, bottom, GRAPH_BORDER_COLOUR )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Subtle terminal-style horizontal guides. --------------------------------------------------------
for grid = 1, 3 do
local gy = top + ( height * grid / 4 )
WindowLine( Win, left + 1, gy, right - 1, gy, GRAPH_GRID_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
end
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, label, left + 4, top + 1, 0, 0, colour, false )
if #history < 2 then
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "Gathering data...", left + 4, top + 12, 0, 0, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
return
end
local minV = math.huge
local maxV = -math.huge
for _,sample in ipairs(history) do
local v = GetGraphValue( sample, key )
if v < minV then minV = v end
if v > maxV then maxV = v end
end
local range = maxV - minV
if range < 1 then range = 1 end
local usableWidth = (right - left) - 10
local usableHeight = height - 14
local graphBottom = bottom - 3
local stepX = usableWidth / ( GRAPH_MAX_SAMPLES - 1 )
local startIndex = GRAPH_MAX_SAMPLES - #history
local prevX = nil local prevY = nil
for i,sample in ipairs(history) do
local x = left + 5 + ( startIndex + i - 1 ) * stepX
local value = GetGraphValue( sample, key )
local normalised = ( value - minV ) / range
local y = graphBottom - ( normalised * usableHeight )
if prevX then
WindowLine( Win, prevX, prevY, x, y, colour, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
end
prevX = x prevY = y
end
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- DRAW ALL GRAPHS ------------------------------------------------------------
function Draw_Graphs(top)
GRAPH_HEIGHT = math.max(55, WINDOW_HEIGHT - top - 14)
local eachHeight = ( GRAPH_HEIGHT - ( GRAPH_GAP * 2 ) ) / 3
local suffix = RateSuffix()
Draw_Single_Graph( top, eachHeight, "xp", XP_COLOUR, "XP"..suffix )
Draw_Single_Graph( top + eachHeight + GRAPH_GAP, eachHeight, "ap", AP_COLOUR, "AP"..suffix )
Draw_Single_Graph( top + ( eachHeight + GRAPH_GAP ) * 2, eachHeight, "gold", GOLD_COLOUR, "Gold"..suffix )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- REDRAW ------------------------------------------------------------
function Redraw_Window()
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BORDER_COLOUR )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Title bar --------------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT, TITLE_COLOUR )
WindowLine( Win, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1, BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, "XP / AP / GOLD RATES", 8, 4, WINDOW_WIDTH - 8, TITLE_HEIGHT, TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR, false )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- RESET / TOGGLE BUTTONS --------------------------------------------------------
local buttonTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + 6
local buttonBottom = TITLE_HEIGHT + 25
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, WINDOW_WIDTH - 106, buttonTop, WINDOW_WIDTH - 58, buttonBottom, GRAPH_BG_COLOUR )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, WINDOW_WIDTH - 106, buttonTop, WINDOW_WIDTH - 58, buttonBottom, BORDER_COLOUR )
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "RESET", WINDOW_WIDTH - 101, buttonTop + 3, WINDOW_WIDTH - 58, buttonBottom, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, WINDOW_WIDTH - 55, buttonTop, WINDOW_WIDTH - 7, buttonBottom, GRAPH_BG_COLOUR )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, WINDOW_WIDTH - 55, buttonTop, WINDOW_WIDTH - 7, buttonBottom, BORDER_COLOUR )
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "TOGGLE", WINDOW_WIDTH - 53, buttonTop + 3, WINDOW_WIDTH - 7, buttonBottom, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Current rates --------------------------------------------------------
local xpRate = GetRate(totalXP)
local apRate = GetRate(totalAP)
local goldRate = GetRate(totalGold)
local suffix = RateSuffix()
local y = TITLE_HEIGHT + 6
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "XP:", TEXT_INSET, y, 0, 0, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win,
FormatNumber(totalXP) .. " (" .. FormatNumber(xpRate) .. suffix .. ")",
valueX, y, 0, 0, XP_COLOUR, false )
y = y + LINE_HEIGHT
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "AP:", TEXT_INSET, y, 0, 0, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win,
FormatNumber(totalAP) .. " (" .. FormatNumber(apRate) .. suffix .. ")",
valueX, y, 0, 0, AP_COLOUR, false )
y = y + LINE_HEIGHT
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "Gold:", TEXT_INSET, y, 0, 0, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win,
FormatNumber(totalGold) .. " (" .. FormatNumber(goldRate) .. suffix .. ")",
valueX, y, 0, 0, GOLD_COLOUR, false )
y = y + LINE_HEIGHT + 2
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "Session: " .. FormatElapsed(),
TEXT_INSET, y, 0, 0, LABEL_COLOUR, false )
y = y + LINE_HEIGHT + 1
Draw_Graphs( y )
InstallResizeHandle() Redraw()
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- XP / AP / GOLD EVENT ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnKillLine( name, line, wildcards )
local xp = stripCommas( wildcards[1] )
local ap = stripCommas( wildcards[2] )
local gold = stripCommas( wildcards[3] )
if xp then totalXP = totalXP + xp end
if ap then totalAP = totalAP + ap end
if gold then totalGold = totalGold + gold end
Redraw_Window()
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- TIMER ------------------------------------------------------------
function TickUpdate()
PushHistorySample()
Redraw_Window()
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- RESET ------------------------------------------------------------
function rate_reset( name, line, wildcards )
totalXP = 0 totalAP = 0 totalGold = 0
sessionStart = os.time()
history = {}
Redraw_Window()
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate tracker reset." )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- SHOW ------------------------------------------------------------
function rate_show( name, line, wildcards )
WindowShow( Win, true )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate window shown." )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- HIDE ------------------------------------------------------------
function rate_hide( name, line, wildcards )
WindowShow( Win, false )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate window hidden." )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- HOURLY MODE ------------------------------------------------------------
function rate_hour( name, line, wildcards )
rateMode = "hour"
SetVariable( "rateMode", rateMode )
Redraw_Window()
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate display set to per hour." )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- PER-MINUTE MODE ------------------------------------------------------------
function rate_minute( name, line, wildcards )
rateMode = "minute"
SetVariable( "rateMode", rateMode )
Redraw_Window()
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate display set to per minute." )
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- TOGGLE MODE ------------------------------------------------------------
function rate_toggle( name, line, wildcards )
if rateMode == "hour" then
rateMode = "minute"
else
rateMode = "hour"
end
SetVariable( "rateMode", rateMode )
Redraw_Window()
if rateMode == "hour" then
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate display set to per hour." )
else
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Rate display set to per minute." )
end
end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- THEME BROADCAST ------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme()
Redraw_Window() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER LAYOUT API --------------------------------------------------
function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, winName, x, y) if type(info) ~= "table" then return end info.window_left = x info.window_top = y info.window_mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 7)) or info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left info.window_flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 8)) or info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() return Win end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= Win then return "wrong window" end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) SaveWindowSize()
WindowResize( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(windowinfo, Win, x, y) Redraw_Window()
local mode = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left local flags = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location WindowPosition(Win, x, y, mode, flags) if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(Win) end pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
